title: Tangipahoa African American Heritage Museum & Veterans Archives

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: The Tangipahoa African American Heritage Museum has been offering summer programs for over a decade, providing a unique educational experience for children in the community. With a primary focus on hands-on STEM/STEAM activities, the museum's summer programs aim to engage campers in interactive learning opportunities that foster creativity and critical thinking skills. By incorporating field trips to local science centers, nature reserves, and technology companies, campers are exposed to real-world applications of STEM concepts, enhancing their understanding and appreciation of these fields. blurb: "Welcome to the Tangipahoa African American Heritage Museum & Veterans Archives. Since we opened our doors in February of 2007, thousands of people have visit our museum to learn more about our African American Heritage. We have a comprehensive collection of African-American murals, artifacts, photographs and artwork that tell our story.
